grune_and_gastef_followup.result: The Grüne source remains an eligible physical experiment but the current repository result is correctly classified as pending because the half-pressure endpoint is not traceable from the accessible raster. GasTeF remains a high-value raw-data request lead, not an available holdout.
grune_and_gastef_followup.claim_limit: Do not digitize the figures into the primary claim or treat the published facility description as access to the underlying logs.

nrc_dispenser_reliability_followup.scope: inspection of the official NRC Canada dispenser-reliability report for machine-readable fueling logs

sources.finding: The report analyzes approximately 22,593 BC fueling events from 2022-2023 and provides protocol context, fault categories, event rates and plotted pressure/temperature/flow examples. The downloaded official PDF contains no CSV/XLSX attachment, raw logger link or machine-readable common-time-base trace.

nrc_dispenser_reliability_followup.result: NRC strengthens independent field face-validity and fault-taxonomy coverage, but it does not expose the synchronized raw logs required for a full-loop numerical holdout. The full-loop gate remains unchanged.
nrc_dispenser_reliability_followup.claim_limit: Do not digitize the report figures for the primary claim or treat aggregate event rates as dynamic validation. Request de-identified station logs, field definitions, quality flags, protocol version and permission to publish derived metrics.
